text:
Anya: Heads-up: planning a short retarget + search burst next week. Proposal: change conversion attribution window from 28d -> 7d for the paid account to surface near-term signal. This will shift reported CPA; want to sync creative, pacing, and lead routing.
Sam: 7d makes sense for the test. Expect short-term noise but faster signal. I can own the creative refresh.
Anya: Thanks. Creative brief: replace current carousel with a 3-card feature-focus carousel, single-image fallback. Tag UTMs with retarget_experiment_C.
Sam: Draft copy variants: A) "Try inference at production scale" B) "Cut token costs, speed up responses" C) "Schedule a 15-min demo". Will A/B vs control.
Leo: Be careful about audience overlap if search and retarget run simultaneously. Recommend frequency cap = 3/day and exclude converters from search after 1 click via MMP sync.
Maria: Where should webinar signups route? SDR webinar queue or demo queue? Also confirm UTM format.
Anya: Webinar -> sdr_webinar_queue. Demo-intent leads -> demo_queue. UTM format: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=retarget_experiment_C&utm_content={variant}. Use exact snippet for ops filtering: "?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=retarget_experiment_C&utm_content=variantA"
Jamie: Budget pacing idea: front-load 30% of test budget in first 48h to reach significance quickly, then throttle. Proposed weekday/weekend split 60/40.
Sam: I'll set a 48h ramp with +15% bid multiplier during 9am-6pm PT for first two days. Daily caps in place.
Leo: Add exclusion for recent webinar registrants (last 30d). Also recommend pausing search exact on hour spikes to avoid frequency burnout.
Maria: HubSpot update queued: created lead property "paid_campaign_tag" = retarget_experiment_C and webhook to #mkt-leads for live lead stream. Routing rule set to sdr_webinar_queue for webinar form.
Anya: Need daily snapshot on the marketing dashboard with impressions, clicks, CTR, convs (7d), CPA (7d), creative_variant. Will review in daily stand.
Sam: I[0m'll push creative_variant dimension into Looker and enable a 6am daily alert.
adops-bot: campaign_scheduler: Created campaign "retarget_experiment_C" (search + retarget). Start=1745076000 (Mon 09:00 PT), budget=USD 6,000, ramp=48h, freq_cap=3/day, conversion_window=7d.
Anya: Great. We'll review after 72h and decide whether to keep 7d or revert to 28d for long-funnel metrics.
Leo: Tagging @growth for overlap FYI.
Sam: Assets uploaded, variant C copy finalized. :rocket:
Maria: Webhook dry-run successful; lead posted to #mkt-leads.
Anya: Daily check-ins first 5 days. If anyone needs to pause, reply in thread. :thumbsup:
